Dr. Michael Rodriguez

Senior Research Scientist

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Dr. Rodriguez specializes in applying evolutionary theory to understand cancer progression and treatment resistance. His interdisciplinary approach combines genomics, mathematical modeling, and clinical data to develop evolution-informed cancer therapies. He has been instrumental in establishing collaborations with major cancer research centers.

Areas of expertise

Cancer Evolution · Computational Biology · Tumor Dynamics

Education as supplied

  • PhD in Cancer Biology, Johns Hopkins University
  • MS in Applied Mathematics, Caltech
  • BS in Biochemistry, UCLA

Research interests

  • Clonal evolution in tumors
  • Adaptive therapy strategies
  • Single-cell genomics
  • Treatment resistance mechanisms

Publication records as supplied

  • Rodriguez, M. et al. (2023). Evolutionary dynamics of treatment resistance in cancer. Cell.
  • Rodriguez, M. & Chen, S. (2022). Phylogenetic approaches to tumor evolution. Cancer Research.
  • Rodriguez, M. et al. (2021). Adaptive therapy design using evolutionary game theory. Nature Medicine.
